note: Keys are anvil public dev keys 0 and 1. Every inner call runs inside the Safe (MultiSend delegatecall), so no address but the Safe ever owns, wears or administers anything. The signatures are plain ecrecover signatures over safeTxHash (v 27 or 28), concatenated in ascending owner order.

calls.purpose: deploy the reference Arbitrator from the Safe (CREATE2, owner = the Safe)
deploy the Reality module (owner, avatar and target = the Safe)
enable the Reality module on the Safe
mint the top hat to the Safe
create the member hat (eligibility and toggle = the Safe)
create the proposer hat (eligibility and toggle = the Safe)
